spatial_reference: Upper/lower refer to fixed cabinet levels. The can is already in one open cabinet at reset; the pre-handoff labels contain no stored-level answer.
high_level_instruction: Retrieve the can. Observe which open cabinet contains it, close both doors in any order, return to neutral, then open the remembered cabinet and bring the can back to the table.

handoff.label: return to the neutral position and establish the memory handoff

place.label: bring the can back and place it on the table
